notes.title: Learn to Fly 3 update and a new release
notes.content:
[h1] Bugfixes and a new item [/h1] 
In honor of the 40th anniversary of Space Invaders, I've bundled up a new body item with this update. Check it out!

[h1] We've released a new game[/h1] 
We've been working hard learning new tools to move away from flash, and we're happy to present our new title, [url=store.steampowered.com/app/716010/Inline/] Inline[/url].

Inline is a relaxed puzzle game with elements from Tetris, but with a focus on strategic placement rather than reflexes and mechanical skills.

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/716010/Inline/] Play Inline Now[/url] 

[h1] Changes in 1.2.13[/h1] 
-Added a new body item, "Pixels"
-Fixed an issue with redeeming codes from the extras menu
-Fixed a bug with redeemed code sometimes not being applied until restarting the game
-Fixed an issue with scene transitions
-Fixed a visual bug in the shop
-Fixed some typos

notes.title: Big changes!
notes.content:
[h1] What's new?[/h1] 
Version 1.2.12 if now out with many tiny tweaks and fixes, but mostly 2 new major features:
[list]
    [*][b]Windowed mode is back![/b]
    [*][b]You can now migrate your saves from Kongregate and ArmorGames to Steam[/b]
[/list] 
[h1] The details[/h1] 
[b]Windowed mode[/b] had been disabled in the game because of an incompatibility between Steam's API and Adobe Air. We've finally managed to have the Steam API load correctly in windowed mode, but the game still requires microtransactions to be done in fullscreen for obscure reasons.

[b]Importing saves[/b] is done by loading the web version of the game either on [url=http://www.kongregate.com/games/light_bringer777/learn-to-fly-3] Kongregate[/url] or [url=http://armorgames.com/play/17987/learn-to-fly-3]ArmorGames[/url], and from the main menu going to "extras" and clicking "Export save". This will generate a block of text that you then copy and paste into the steam version again from the main menu, "extras" and "import save".

You'll then be prompted to pick between your steam and web save data, [b]and your black market content will automatically be added[/b] to your steam account. Sardines, unlocked content, consumables... Everything from the web version will carry over to Steam with no negative effects (e.g. if you didn't have content unlocked on the web but did on steam, [b]importing your save will not remove your unlocked content[/b]

Finally there have been a few minor balance tweaks, bug fixes and typos fixed throughout the game, but no extra content or any other major changes took place.

notes.title: Learn to Fly 3 coming May 12
notes.content:
The port is complete and the Steam review process is over.

Learn to Fly 3 will be coming to Steam this Friday around 3PM EST time!
